io_contract: Reads one line from stdin. Counts UTF-8 CJK characters and prints the count, then prints one 'Woof! (汪汪)' line per pair of CJK characters. If no CJK characters are present, prints a sleeping-dog message instead.
Reads one line from stdin. If the line (without trailing newline) equals '喵喵喵', prints '喵!' followed by a newline; otherwise prints '喵?' followed by a newline.
Reads one line from stdin. If it consists only of digits, prints the digit count, the sum of the first and last digits, and a frequency table of each digit. Otherwise prints 'not a digit string'.
Reads one positive integer (number of days) from stdin. Prints a per-day status line and a summary of how many days the moon worked versus slacked. Exits with status 1 on invalid input.
Reads one integer from stdin (number of tokens the cat types). Prints the generated token sequence and a playful verdict to stdout. Exits 1 on invalid input.
Reads one line from stdin. If it equals '你好世界' (UTF-8), prints 'Hello, world!'; otherwise prints 'Not the expected greeting, but hello anyway!'.
Reads one line from stdin. Prints the length and whether it is odd or even. If the length is odd, prints the line unchanged; if even, prints it reversed. Empty input prints 'empty'.
